Shell completion helper

Usage:
  goal completion [flags]
  goal completion [command]

Available Commands:
  bash        Generate bash completion commands
  zsh         Generate zsh completion commands

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for completion

Global Flags:
  -d, --datadir stringArray   Data directory for the node
  -k, --kmddir string         Data directory for kmd

Use "goal completion [command] --help" for more information about a command.
